closest.title: Cloud Engineer - Husqvarna Group
closest.text: Last date to apply: 31 sierpnia 2026 🌳🌲🌿 Welcome to Cloud Center of Excellence - a part of Global Information Services (GIS) within Husqvarna Group! We’re empowering our company through sustainable technology and data. Join the global Husqvarna Group IT department, diretly Global Information Services (GIS) and be part of a dynamic, forward-thinking and global team, playing an important part of our business development and innovation. Our aim is to ensure that we have the necessary technology, tools and infrastructure - to operate efficiently. We are responsible for managing technological infrastructure, software, data, and cybersecurity. With evolving technology, we are committed to meet future business needs. Our IT department is a global and diverse team with a wide variety of backgrounds, areas of expertise, and perspectives. With more than 200 people in the team, we are present almost all over the world. 👉🏼 What we do in Cloud Center of Excellence team: Our main goal is to provide a secure, functional, effective cloud platform for all Husqvarna’s solution teams. We use reusable Bicep modules and landing zone templates that align with security, compliance and service management policies. Also, we build and maintain a functional Cloud platform in alignment with operational procedures. We review and approve the use of cloud-native tools and strive to standardize and automate commonly needed platform components and solutions. 👉🏼 About the role: If you work/would like to work with cloud technology, bring real life value to our production focused business, work and build a great cloud competency team with “fun and responsibility” approach, Husqvarna CCoE is the right place for you! You do not need to meet every requirement. If you have experience in some of below mentioned areas and are eager to learn, we would like to hear from you. You'll work alongside senior Architects on Azure platform production components - expect to learn ALZ, Entra ID governance, and networking patterns hands-on. We also keep learning and expanding our capabilities - we can do it together! 👉🏼 As a part of our CCoE team, you will: Apply cloud and service-oriented architecture principles to help define, manage, and continuously improve the organization’s cloud architecture. Propose ideas and share best practices to optimize internal customers’ cloud environments in terms of performance, security, reliability, and cost. Debug, troubleshoot, modify, and unit-test custom solutions built on the organization’s cloud platforms. Create technical specifications, documentation and contribute to the development of technical procedures and user support guides. Develop, organize, and maintain cloud systems, working closely with IT Security to support cloud security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Contribute to the Bicep module repository and landing zone templates used by solution teams. Support the onboarding of new workloads to the Azure platform, including subscriptions, networking, identity, and policy configuration. Triage and resolve platform support requests from solution teams via ServiceNow. Document reusable cloud patterns and contribute to the CCoE knowledge base in Confluence. 👉🏼 What we offer: Husqvarna Group offers a global dynamic workplace with a lot of potential for a person who is willing to take on responsibility. Join our team for a workplace that champions open communication and exchange of experiences, work-life balance and a thriving feedback culture. 🌻 We offer you a set of very attractive employee benefits: A unique package of social benefits: MultiSport card, private medical care, group insurance, lunch card, cafeteria benefits, as well as discounts on our products :) Working in a dynamic and fast-growing team in the international environment Work in the prestigious Forest office building in Warsaw with green rooftop overlooking the city skyline (near the Arkadia SC) A hybrid working model with flexibility of 2 days per week available for remote work 🌿☀ 👉🏼 Your skills and experiences: You have 1-100 years of work experience designing, executing and supporting Cloud solutions in Azure. Also, you are passionate about sustainable cloud solutions and new innovations in the connected world. 👉🏼 You should most likely have some of the following skills: Required skills and experience (junior/mid baseline): Experience designing and implementing cloud architectures. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, particularly in the following areas: compute, networking, identity, or storage. Basic knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools, such as Bicep, ARM templates with a willingness to learn Bicep if you have not worked with it before. Understanding of Git and CI/CD concepts (Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions). Understanding of RBAC and Entra ID fundamentals. Scripting experience in PowerShell, Python, or C#. Experience operating, supporting, or maintaining cloud workloads and services. Familiarity with DevOps or DevSecOps practices. Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and basic log analysis using KQL. Experience building or supporting secure Azure network configurations, including private networking, private endpoints, custom routing, and Azure Private DNS. Good understanding of Azure networking components, such as Azure Firewall, Application Gateway, Load Balancer, Network Security Groups, virtual networks, and VNet peering. Nice-to-have skills and growth opportunities: Experience with Azure Landing Zones or Enterprise-Scale architecture. Experience working in hybrid environments, combining on-premises infrastructure with Microsoft Azure. Good understanding of Azure governance concepts, including management groups, built-in and custom roles, and Azure RBAC. Familiarity with Azure monitoring concepts, including Data Collection Rules and Diagnostic Settings. Experience with hub-and-spoke networking models and Azure Virtual WAN. Experience troubleshooting network-related issues using native Azure services, such as Network Watcher, or third-party tools, such as Wireshark. Experience building automated solutions using Azure DevOps, Logic Apps, Automation Accounts, Azure Functions, and API integrations. Experience with cloud migration projects, including migrating applications from public to private Azure networking using private endpoints and Azure Private DNS. Familiarity with container technologies and platforms, such as AKS, Azure Red Hat OpenShift, Azure Container Apps, or Kubernetes in general. Knowledge of Azure Policy and its use in enforcing governance, compliance, and security standards. Azure certifications such as AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-700, or SC-300. Exposure to AI-related Azure services or concepts, such as Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AI Landing Zones, or similar technologies. 👉🏼 About you: Are you self-motivated, service-minded, and driven to deliver high-quality solutions? Do you communicate clearly, enjoy working with cross-functional teams, and feel comfortable engaging with stakeholders in an international environment? Are you curious, proactive, and eager to apply best practices while continuously learning and improving? Do you have relevant certifications and strong English skills? If so, we encourage you to apply for this position. Your application: Can you envision yourself being a part of this? If so, apply as soon as possible. We apply ongoing selection and do not accept applications via mail due to GDPR. What happens after you have applied? We will review your application carefully to see if your profile matches the requirements of the vacant position. If we believe you are a potential candidate for the role, you will be invited for an initial interview. If you aren’t chosen to proceed in the process, you will be informed of this at the latest when the position has been filled.

closest.title: Data Engineer - AI, Agents, & Context - Clinical (Sr. Associate)
closest.text: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. Role Summary This role sits within a strategic investment to embed AI into how we operate, serve customers, and make decisions within our healthcare business. We're building a healthcare-wide AI data and context platform with a focus on deep domain expertise embedded throughout our architecture. Our goals are: Turn structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable "building blocks" (semantic layers, retrieval services, and agent-ready interfaces) that accelerate product innovation Deliver transformational speed and leverage — faster time-to-insight, higher automation of knowledge work, and a foundation that scales AI safely and reliably as adoption grows Unlock new capabilities across our business and create the foundation that drives deeper domain innovation and cross-domain collaboration This is a hands-on technical contributor who builds and maintains core AI/context data capabilities. The role executes key parts of the AI context platform — unstructured ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and semantic layers — working closely with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to ship reliable, production-grade AI data products. Key Responsibilities Build and contribute to the AI context platform Implement end-to-end pipelines: ingestion → parsing/chunking → enrichment → embeddings → vector indexing → retrieval/serving Build and maintain patterns for incremental refresh, backfills, re-embeddings, deduplication, and lineage across unstructured sources Contribute to retrieval quality improvements (query strategies, hybrid search, metadata filtering) in partnership with AI engineers Deliver semantic and governed data products Implement semantic layers (metrics/entities) that power BI and agent reasoning consistently Apply established data contracts and context contracts for AI inputs (schemas, metadata requirements, freshness, citation expectations) Ensure datasets and indexes are documented and reusable Operational excellence Support reliability and performance across assigned workstreams: monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and incident response Contribute to cost and latency optimization across warehouse/ lakehouse and vector infrastructure AI safety and compliance Apply security-by-design patterns: RBAC/ABAC, PII redaction, retention controls, and audit logging Follow established guardrails for AI access to enterprise knowledge in coordination with Security/Legal/Compliance Travel Expectations Ability to travel as needed up to 4 times per year. Required Qualifications BA or BS required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a technology-based discipline 3–6 years in data engineering or data platform roles with strong hands-on delivery Strong SQL and Python (or Scala/Java); solid production engineering habits Experience designing and operating cloud data pipelines at scale Experience working with unstructured data processing and search/retrieval concepts Clear communicator who can work effectively across technical and functional teams Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with vector search and embeddings ( pgvector /Pinecone/ Weaviate /OpenSearch/Elastic) and retrieval patterns (semantic retrieval, hybrid search, reranking) Experience supporting LLM applications (RAG, agent tool interfaces, evaluation/observability) Familiarity with knowledge graphs/semantic modeling or metrics layers Experience in regulated environments and data governance programs Example Success Measures Measurable improvement in AI outcomes: higher retrieval precision/recall, better citation coverage, fewer "missing context" failures Reduced latency/cost per retrieval and improved platform reliability (SLO attainment, lower MTTR) Consistent application of semantic definitions and context contracts across assigned workstreams Delivery quality: production-ready outputs with minimal rework, well-documented and maintainable Behavioral Attributes Eager to learn the domain: Proactively builds familiarity with healthcare processes, terminology, and KPIs — can engage credibly with SMEs and ask the right clarifying questions Collaborative and stakeholder-aware: Works well with engineers, consultants, and functional partners; communicates progress and flags risks clearly Consultative problem-solver: Approaches requests with a "diagnose before prescribe" mindset — proposes options and works toward durable solutions rather than one-off fixes High ownership and follow-through: Treats reliability, documentation, and operational readiness as part of the work; finishes what they start; holds a high bar for production quality Clear communicator: Can go deep with engineers and explain concepts plainly to non-technical partners; writes solid docs and runbooks Pragmatic builder: Biases toward shipping value in iterations, validating with users, and improving based on feedback Comfortable with ambiguity: Adapts quickly in evolving AI/data product environments and turns unclear goals into actionable tasks Integrity and stewardship: Handles sensitive data responsibly and respects established governance patterns The estimated base salary for this job is $110,000 - $150,000 USD. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. closestEng.text: Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes. Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients. Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. Role Summary This role sits within a strategic investment to embed AI into how we operate, serve customers, and make decisions within our healthcare business. We're building a healthcare-wide AI data and context platform with a focus on deep domain expertise embedded throughout our architecture. Our goals are: Turn structured and unstructured information into trusted, reusable "building blocks" (semantic layers, retrieval services, and agent-ready interfaces) that accelerate product innovation Deliver transformational speed and leverage — faster time-to-insight, higher automation of knowledge work, and a foundation that scales AI safely and reliably as adoption grows Unlock new capabilities across our business and create the foundation that drives deeper domain innovation and cross-domain collaboration This is a hands-on technical contributor who builds and maintains core AI/context data capabilities. The role executes key parts of the AI context platform — unstructured ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and semantic layers — working closely with senior engineers and cross-functional partners to ship reliable, production-grade AI data products. Required Qualifications BA or BS required, preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, or a technology-based discipline 3–6 years in data engineering or data platform roles with strong hands-on delivery Strong SQL and Python (or Scala/Java); solid production engineering habits Experience designing and operating cloud data pipelines at scale Experience working with unstructured data processing and search/retrieval concepts Clear communicator who can work effectively across technical and functional teams Preferred Qualifications Hands-on experience with vector search and embeddings ( pgvector /Pinecone/ Weaviate /OpenSearch/Elastic) and retrieval patterns (semantic retrieval, hybrid search, reranking) Experience supporting LLM applications (RAG, agent tool interfaces, evaluation/observability) Familiarity with knowledge graphs/semantic modeling or metrics layers Experience in regulated environments and data governance programs Example Success Measures Measurable improvement in AI outcomes: higher retrieval precision/recall, better citation coverage, fewer "missing context" failures Reduced latency/cost per retrieval and improved platform reliability (SLO attainment, lower MTTR) Consistent application of semantic definitions and context contracts across assigned workstreams Delivery quality: production-ready outputs with minimal rework, well-documented and maintainable Behavioral Attributes Eager to learn the domain: Proactively builds familiarity with healthcare processes, terminology, and KPIs — can engage credibly with SMEs and ask the right clarifying questions Collaborative and stakeholder-aware: Works well with engineers, consultants, and functional partners; matches.title: Associate Technical Services Engineer
matches.text: Overview Associate Technical Services Engineer Position Overview : We are seeking an Associate Technical Services Engineer who will provide frontline product and technical support to customers, troubleshooting issues, identifying solutions, and ensuring timely resolution within SLA guidelines. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and drive continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a proactive learning mindset and thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift rapidly based on customer needs. Our Products: HealthEdge® delivers an entire healthcare ecosystem, providing customers with one set of healthcare solutions to manage all their complex needs and prepare for the future. Deployed individually or in combination, these healthcare solutions deliver what health plans need to succeed in an ever-changing market while ushering in the future of healthcare Key Responsibilities: Provide first-line product and technical support by diagnosing customer issues, researching solutions, and resolving tickets within established SLA guidelines Troubleshoot technical problems through systematic analysis and collaborate cross-functionally to identify root causes and implement effective solutions Triage and prioritize customer issues, delivering timely workarounds and guiding users on best practices and preventive measures Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining clear communication with customers throughout the resolution process Contribute to knowledge base documentation and develop reusable scripts to improve team efficiency and customer self-service capabilities Maintain flexible availability to support customer needs across time zones, including occasional early morning or evening shifts (India time) for US team collaboration Additional Role-Specific Competencies Actively seeks feedback and engages in self-assessment for continuous improvement. Participates in mobbing sessions and team learning activities. Identifies and updates missing or inaccurate documentation. Demonstrates adaptability to new tools and processes. Communicates clearly with customers and documents next steps effectively. What you bring: Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 0-2 years of experience in analysis, maintenance, support, implementation, and testing of software systems using Java, J2EE, and internet technologies. Preferably, experience in the health insurance industry, particularly with healthcare payors. 1+ years of experience as a Business Analyst is a plus. Business & Analytical Skills: Strong aptitude for critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving. Ability to document standard operating procedures and manage ticket lifecycles using tools like Salesforce and Jira. Experience engaging with customers and managing competing priorities effectively. Technical Proficiency: We're looking for associates with technical curiosity and strong learning aptitude. While prior experience is a plus, we value the ability to quickly absorb new concepts and grow into these technical areas: Java-based applications and troubleshooting SQL query development and debugging Relational databases and version control Web services (SOAP/REST) Data formats and log analysis UNIX command-line basics Soft Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to prioritize issues, manage schedules, and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, driven mindset with a strong desire to understand both business and technical problems.

matches.title: Software Engineer (.Net Full-Stack)
matches.text: Overview Software Engineer (Care Solution Bengaluru): Position Overview: We are seeking a talented Software Engineer to join our Bengaluru-based team, focusing on developing and maintaining code for GuidingCare while supporting integration features with Wellframe. This role offers an excellent opportunity for engineers with 2-4 years of experience to work on innovative healthcare solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams. You'll contribute to building a cutting-edge Digital Health Management platform that meaningfully impacts patient care and health outcomes. RESPONSIBILITIES Development & Implementation : Design, develop, and maintain software solutions for Care-Wellframe integration using modern technologies and frameworks. Leverage AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot) and agentic AI workflows to accelerate development and improve code quality. Code Quality : Write clean, optimized, and well-documented code following industry best practices and coding standards. Feature Development : Build application features, user interfaces, and databases that support seamless integration between GuidingCare and Wellframe. Testing & Debugging : Develop and execute unit test cases, debug existing code, and ensure products function correctly in controlled environments before deployment. Data Management : Work with large volumes of data, ensuring proper modeling, analysis, and management. Collaboration : Partner with multidisciplinary teams including product managers, designers, and senior engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions. Learning & Growth : Actively seek opportunities to learn new technologies and methodologies while contributing to innovative solutions. Problem Solving : Troubleshoot and resolve technical challenges within software systems, ensuring robustness and customer satisfaction. On-call Support : Participate in on-call rotations to support the systems owned by your team. nearMatches.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
nearMatches.text: Overview Overview: HealthEdge provides the only modern, enterprise-class software platform for healthcare payers. Using the patented HealthRules software suite, health plans, health insurance companies, and other payers can finally respond to new business opportunities and market changes in hours, not months or years, while drastically reducing both IT and operational costs. Leveraging an investment of over $125 million, HealthRules is the most modern, scalable, and cost-effective technology in the industry. HealthEdge is the only choice for payers to survive and thrive in the emerging healthcare economy. Our Software Engineers in Test are embedded alongside developers, using our latest in-house automation framework in Java to create reliable and comprehensive automation tests. Teams rely on flexible but standardized processes to ensure test coverage, feature quality, and regression checks. What you will do: Develop automation in existing tools and frameworks and extend those tools and frameworks as necessary. Execute both white- and black-box testing. Create and execute test plans and test cases based on requirements and user stories revolving around complex data scenarios. Identify current testing gaps, process flaws, suggest and implement improvements to increase product quality. Contribute to the relevant DevOps work and help improve the CI/CD for the team. Interact with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and drive projects to on-time, seamless releases. Participate in product Demos. You get excited by: Understanding, testing and debugging complex, data-drive applications. Routinely digging into code to help identify the root cause of a defect and helping to design a solution. What you bring: 5+ years of professional experience working in a software development environment. Ability to write automated test code and tools. Expert in both UI test automation tools (Katalon, Cypress or similar) and API testing (using soapUI, RestAssured, or similar). Experience with performance testing (using Jmeter, K6 or similar). Experience using a broad range of test automation frameworks (e.g. Cucumber, Rspec, Fitness, TestNG or similar). Proficiency with Object Oriented languages (Java, C#, C++ or similar). Proficiency with scripting languages (JavaScript, Python, Ruby or similar). Working with relation databases (Oracle, MySQL or similar). Familiarity with SDLC practices of Agile (Lean, Scrum, XP or similar). Experience working with Devops tools like Ansible, Jenkins and practices like continuous integration and delivery pipelines. Strong analytical and problem solving skills Familiarity with enterprise architecture and SOA best practices. Strong experience with distributed source code control systems, like Git. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Great team player and collaborates well with Onshore/Offshore teams. Working knowledge of Docker a plus. Working knowledge of Linux a plus. Experience working with WebLogic application server a plus. Experience in Healthcare domain a plus. Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or related technical field or equivalent technical experience. nearMatches.title: DevOps Engineer

You will be the connective tissue between development and operations — accelerating delivery pipelines, strengthening cloud infrastructure, and ensuring the reliability of critical healthcare systems. As a DevOps Engineer, this is your opportunity to: Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Java-based microservices and enterprise healthcare applications using tools like GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or similar. Customize CI/CD pipelines, including build stages, test automation, artifact management, and deployment strategies. Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools). Deploy, and manage AWS cloud infrastructure, including EC2, S3, ECS/EKS, RDS, and networking components. Handle storage and access configurations such as S3 bucket policies, IAM roles, file permissions, and mount/server path configurations (EFS/NFS). closest.title: Associate Technical Services Engineer
closest.text: Overview Associate Technical Services Engineer Position Overview : We are seeking an Associate Technical Services Engineer who will provide frontline product and technical support to customers, troubleshooting issues, identifying solutions, and ensuring timely resolution within SLA guidelines. This role requires strong problem-solving skills, effective communication, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences and drive continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a proactive learning mindset and thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities can shift rapidly based on customer needs. Our Products: HealthEdge® delivers an entire healthcare ecosystem, providing customers with one set of healthcare solutions to manage all their complex needs and prepare for the future. Deployed individually or in combination, these healthcare solutions deliver what health plans need to succeed in an ever-changing market while ushering in the future of healthcare Key Responsibilities: Provide first-line product and technical support by diagnosing customer issues, researching solutions, and resolving tickets within established SLA guidelines Troubleshoot technical problems through systematic analysis and collaborate cross-functionally to identify root causes and implement effective solutions Triage and prioritize customer issues, delivering timely workarounds and guiding users on best practices and preventive measures Escalate complex issues appropriately while maintaining clear communication with customers throughout the resolution process Contribute to knowledge base documentation and develop reusable scripts to improve team efficiency and customer self-service capabilities Maintain flexible availability to support customer needs across time zones, including occasional early morning or evening shifts (India time) for US team collaboration Additional Role-Specific Competencies Actively seeks feedback and engages in self-assessment for continuous improvement. Participates in mobbing sessions and team learning activities. Identifies and updates missing or inaccurate documentation. Demonstrates adaptability to new tools and processes. Communicates clearly with customers and documents next steps effectively. What you bring: Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 0-2 years of experience in analysis, maintenance, support, implementation, and testing of software systems using Java, J2EE, and internet technologies. Preferably, experience in the health insurance industry, particularly with healthcare payors. 1+ years of experience as a Business Analyst is a plus. Business & Analytical Skills: Strong aptitude for critical thinking, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving. Ability to document standard operating procedures and manage ticket lifecycles using tools like Salesforce and Jira. Experience engaging with customers and managing competing priorities effectively. Technical Proficiency: We're looking for associates with technical curiosity and strong learning aptitude. While prior experience is a plus, we value the ability to quickly absorb new concepts and grow into these technical areas: Java-based applications and troubleshooting SQL query development and debugging Relational databases and version control Web services (SOAP/REST) Data formats and log analysis UNIX command-line basics Soft Skills: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to prioritize issues, manage schedules, and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. A proactive, driven mindset with a strong desire to understand both business and technical problems.

closest.title: Junior RTCDP Developer
closest.text: Job Title: Junior RTCDP Developer About Hashout Technologies Hashout Technologies is a client-centric digital transformation partner specializing in Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) and the broader Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem , including personalization, data/CDP, journey orchestration, and campaign management . We deliver highly customizable, outcome-driven MarTech solutions , leveraging our expertise across leading CMS platforms to build tailored digital experiences that align with our clients’ needs and drive measurable business growth. Position Details Role: Junior RTCDP Developer Location: Remote Experience Required: 3+ Role Overview This role is suited for a data or marketing technology professional who is building expertise in customer data platforms and audience management. The candidate will work alongside senior RTCDP developers, contributing to segment builds, identity configuration, destination setup, and use case documentation in a structured environment. Prior exposure to a DMP or CDP is a strong advantage. Relevant Backgrounds Candidates may come from any of the following areas: Adobe Audience Manager or comparable DMP roles with exposure to segment creation, trait management, and basic destination configuration. CDP or Marketing Automation roles where audience building, list management, and activation to downstream platforms were part of day-to-day responsibilities. Data or Analytics roles with an understanding of identity concepts, audience segmentation logic, and marketing channel activation. Graduate or early career roles in a Martech, AdTech, or data platform environment with hands on exposure to audience or profile data workflows. Key Responsibilities Support the design and build of RTCDP use cases by contributing to segment creation, identity configuration, and activation setup under senior guidance. Assist in configuring Identity Namespaces and understanding how the Identity Graph resolves and links profiles across sources and devices. Contribute to the setup and management of Profile Merge Policies with an understanding of how Merge Rules and Graph Unlink Rules affect profile unification outcomes. Build and manage audience segments using RTCDP segmentation capabilities including batch and streaming segmentation, with growing awareness of edge segmentation use cases. Support Destination configuration and activation workflows including assisting with identity mapping, segment assignment, and monitoring activation runs. Develop an understanding of audience publishing mechanics including how segments are exported, how identity is matched at the destination, and how incremental versus full exports behave. Assist in applying data governance controls including DULE labels and consent policies to ensure compliant audience activation. Contribute to use case documentation including segment definitions, merge policy configurations, and activation workflow notes. Support troubleshooting of profile and segment issues with guidance from senior developers, developing the ability to diagnose identity graph and activation problems over time. Required Skills and Experience Foundational understanding of customer data platforms, data management platforms, or audience management concepts, with hands on exposure to at least one platform such as Adobe Audience Manager, a CDP, or a Marketing Automation tool. Awareness of identity resolution concepts including how profiles are unified across devices, channels, and identifiers. Basic experience building audience segments or lists based on behavioural, demographic, or transactional criteria. Familiarity with how audiences are activated or shared to downstream destinations such as paid media platforms, email tools, or advertising networks. Understanding of data governance principles and a willingness to learn DULE compliance and consent frameworks within AEP. Organised approach to documentation, task management, and delivery across concurrent use case workstreams. Curiosity about the evolving CDP and identity landscape and a genuine interest in building deep RTCDP expertise over time.

closest.title: OT Cybersecurity Engineer
closest.text: OT Cybersecurity Engineer The OT Cybersecurity Engineer safeguards the global Operational Technology (OT) ecosystem across manufacturing sites in Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Operating from India, this role leads OT security assessments, designs secure architectures aligned to ISA/IEC 62443 and NIST frameworks, and drives continuous monitoring, governance, and risk reduction across PLCs, SCADA, DCS, industrial IoT, and MES environments. Key Responsibilities Conduct OT/ICS security assessments across global manufacturing sites. Perform risk and gap analyses against ISA/IEC 62443 , NIST , and ICS‑CERT guidelines. Maintain OT asset inventories including firmware versions, network diagrams, and data flows. Design and enforce segmentation aligned to the Purdue Model . Recommend and oversee deployment of OT‑specific security controls. Serve as the primary OT security contact for each facility. Lead OT‑specific incident response planning and tabletop exercises. Develop OT security policies, standards, and governance aligned to ISO 27001 and ISA 62443. Track OT threat intelligence and update risk registers accordingly. Promote OT security awareness across engineering and operations teams. Drive automation, standardization, and modernization to improve service quality, reduce manual effort, and increase operational maturity. Evaluate and apply AI‑driven capabilities to improve operational efficiency, strengthen insights, and accelerate automation while maintaining governance and control. Required Qualifications 10+ years of cybersecurity experience with 5+ years focused on OT/ICS environments. Deep expertise with ISA/IEC 62443 , NIST , NERC CIP , or equivalent OT frameworks. Proven experience securing SCADA, DCS, and PLC systems (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider Electric, ABB, GE, etc.). Strong understanding of industrial network architecture, the Purdue Model , OT/IT DMZ design, and protocol security. Experience working in multi‑site, globally distributed manufacturing environments. Ability to operate independently and drive assessments, planning, communication, and execution. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience in network security, firewall management, and segmentation. Experience with OT security monitoring platforms. Knowledge of Industry 4.0 technologies including IIoT, MES, and digital twins. Familiarity with cloud‑connected OT environments and secure remote access architectures. Who we are: Mold-Masters ( www.moldmasters.com ) is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand. Hillenbrand ( www.hillenbrand.com ) is a global industrial company that provides highly engineered, mission-critical processing equipment and solutions to customers in over 100 countries around the world. Our portfolio is composed of leading industrial brands that serve large, attractive end markets, including durable plastics, food, and recycling. Guided by our Purpose — Shape What Matters For Tomorrow™ — we pursue excellence, collaboration, and innovation to consistently shape solutions that best serve our associates, customers, communities, and other stakeholders. closestEng.title: Tech Lead - Backend (AI)
closestEng.text: Job Title: Tech Lead - Backend (AI) Location: Bengaluru About Us At Habuild , we’re on a mission to help people build healthier habits and live better lives. With a vision to create a healthier, happier world, we’ve already impacted over 9 million lives through our wellness-driven ecosystem rooted in consistency, discipline, and daily action. From yoga to mindfulness and fitness, our products and community enable people to unlock their best selves and make well-being a part of everyday life. One of our flagship initiatives is an AI-powered conversational assistant that uses cutting-edge LLM technology to deliver context-aware, intelligent responses to thousands of users in real-time. We're not just a startup—we're a movement, and we're growing fast. If you're driven by purpose, passion, and the power of technology to transform lives, Habuild is the place for you. Role Overview As a Technical Lead - Backend (AI) , you will lead the architecture, design, and implementation of backend systems that serve millions of users. You’ll work hands-on with the codebase, mentor engineers, and ensure our backend is scalable, performant, and future-ready. The role demands deep expertise in Python (FastAPI), async programming, and distributed systems, along with strong leadership skills to guide complex projects from concept to deployment. We’re looking for a tinkerer at heart —someone who stays ahead of tech trends, experiments with new tools and ideas, and isn’t afraid to build quick prototypes or side projects to push the boundaries of what’s possible. Key Responsibilities Foster a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing within the team. Posses high knowledge and ability to engineer out of the box solutions for complex problems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver features that delight users. Own and drive the technical roadmap for core backend systems. Architect and build scalable, fault-tolerant microservices in FastAPI. Design and optimize asynchronous workflows for high-performance API calls. Integrate with vector databases and AI/ML APIs for intelligent, data-driven services. Guide design decisions on system architecture, database schema, and service orchestration. closest.text: Job Title: Junior Influencer Marketing Specialist Company: Qoruz Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India Work Mode: On-site Employment Type: Full-time Experience Level: 2+ Years Industry: Influencer Marketing | Creator Economy | Marketing Technology | Digital Marketing Salary: Not Disclosed About Qoruz Qoruz is a leading influencer marketing and creator intelligence platform that enables brands to discover, collaborate with, and measure the impact of creators through data-driven marketing solutions. The company partners with leading brands and agencies to execute high-performing influencer campaigns across India’s growing creator economy. Role Overview Qoruz is hiring a Junior Influencer Marketing Specialist to coordinate influencer campaigns, manage creator relationships, and support campaign execution from planning to reporting. This influencer marketing job in Bengaluru is ideal for professionals with experience in creator partnerships, campaign coordination, and digital marketing. In this role, you’ll collaborate with creators, internal marketing teams, and brand partners while ensuring smooth campaign execution, performance tracking, and long-term creator engagement. Key Responsibilities Coordinate end-to-end influencer marketing campaigns across multiple industries. Identify, onboard, and maintain relationships with creators and talent managers. Manage campaign timelines, content approvals, deliverables, and creator communications. Monitor campaign performance and prepare reports with actionable insights. Stay updated with creator economy trends, viral content, and platform updates. Collaborate with sales, strategy, and content teams to deliver successful campaigns. Ensure campaign execution aligns with brand objectives and deadlines. Maintain campaign documentation and influencer databases. Support creator relationship management and campaign optimization. Recommend improvements based on campaign performance and market trends. Skills and Qualifications Required 2+ years of experience in influencer marketing, social media marketing, or creator partnerships. Excellent communication and relationship management skills. Strong understanding of influencer campaigns and digital marketing metrics. Knowledge of Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and emerging creator platforms. Strong organizational and project management abilities. Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment. Problem-solving mindset with excellent attention to detail. Nice to Have Experience working with brands, marketing agencies, or creator-tech platforms. Familiarity with influencer marketing software and campaign analytics tools. Knowledge of social media reporting and ROI measurement. Existing network of creators or influencer agencies. Experience managing multiple influencer campaigns simultaneously. Why Join Qoruz? Work with leading brands, creators, and influencer marketing experts. Be part of one of India’s fastest-growing creator-tech companies. Gain hands-on experience managing impactful influencer campaigns. Collaborative and creator-first work culture. High ownership and excellent learning opportunities. Exposure to the latest trends in influencer marketing and creator analytics. Opportunity to build a rewarding career in the creator economy. Continuous professional growth in a dynamic startup environment. Apply Today If you’re passionate about influencer marketing, creator partnerships, and building successful digital campaigns, we’d love to hear from you. Join Qoruz and help shape the future of creator marketing through innovation, collaboration, and technology. We look forward to hearing from you soon! closest.text: Job Overview Role Summary The System Integration Test Engineer is responsible for executing system integration testing (SIT) across applications, devices, APIs, and data systems to ensure overall product quality and reliability. This role focuses on validating end-to-end workflows, performing functional and performance testing, and leveraging modern tools, automation, AI techniques, and database validation to support high-quality releases. A Day In The Life Key Responsibilities System Integration Testing Execute end-to-end SIT scenarios across multiple systems, including APIs, backend services, and user interfaces Validate data flow, integration points, and system interactions Identify, log, and track defects, integration issues, and inconsistencies Support test planning, test case creation, and test execution Automation & Modern Testing Tools Develop and execute automation scripts for regression and integration testing Work with tools such as: Selenium / Cypress (UI testing) Postman / REST Assured (API testing) Contribute to test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines Performance & Load Testing (Basic) Assist in executing load and performance tests using tools such as: JMeter / k6 Analyze test results and identify basic performance bottlenecks AI-Assisted Testing (Emerging Skills) Use AI-powered testing tools for: Test case generation Defect prediction Analysis of test results Support implementation of intelligent automation practices Database & Data Validation Validate data integrity across systems using: SQL queries Data comparison techniques Work with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL) Verify ETL/data pipeline accuracy and consistency Defect Management & Troubleshooting Log and manage defects using tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps Perform basic root cause analysis with guidance from senior engineers Collaborate with development teams to resolve issues Collaboration & Agile Participation Work in Agile/Scrum teams, participating in: Sprint planning Daily stand-ups Retrospectives Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and QA teams What will help you thrive in this role? Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field 2+ years of experience in: Software testing / QA System Integration Testing (preferred) Technical Skills Testing Tools API Testing: Postman, REST Assured UI Testing: Selenium, Cypress Test Management: JIRA, Azure DevOps Performance Testing (Basic) JMeter, k6 (preferred) Programming / Scripting Basic knowledge of: Python / Java / JavaScript Database Skills Strong SQL fundamentals Experience querying and validating data AI Tools (Preferred) Exposure to AI-based testing tools or frameworks is a plus Familiarity with automation optimization using AI Other Skills Understanding of SDLC and STLC processes Basic knowledge of API architecture and microservices Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure/AWS) is a plus Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Attention to detail and quality focus Good communication and collaboration skills Ability to learn new tools and technologies quickly Proactive mindset toward automation and innovation Preferred Experience Exposure to integration testing across multiple systems Knowledge of basic performance testing concepts Experience working with Agile teams Success Metrics Test coverage and execution completeness Defect detection effectiveness Contribution to automation and efficiency improvements Accuracy of data and integration validation Hubbell Incorporated Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe. Hubbell Utility Solutions Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible. closest.text: Job Description : Project & Maintenance Engineer (m/w/d) At Huntsman Advanced Materials , we are looking for an experienced Project & Maintenance Engineer to join our team in Bad Säckingen. The role will support a variety of site projects, including automotive-related investments, as well as maintenance activities and continuous improvement initiatives at the site. This position is suitable for someone who enjoys hands-on engineering work, project coordination and close collaboration with production, maintenance and external partners. Your Responsibilities As our Project & Maintenance Engineer (m/w/d), you will: Support key site projects – including automotive-related investments and other technical improvement projects, helping to deliver them on time, within budget and in line with technical requirements. Ensure reliable site operations – support preventive and corrective maintenance for production equipment, utilities and infrastructure. Maintain EHS and compliance standards – ensure activities follow Huntsman’s safety, environmental and quality requirements, including relevant standards such as ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and IATF 16949. Contribute to continuous improvement – work with site management, production, supply chain and external partners on process changes, new product introductions and automation topics. What We’re Looking For We are searching for a proactive, hands-on engineer with: A degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related field). 3+ years’ experience in engineering and maintenance roles within manufacturing, ideally with a strong automotive or chemical background. Proven success in managing projects and delivering technical readiness for automotive standards and audits. Excellent project management, problem-solving, and communication skills. A proactive, hands‑on, can‑do attitude Fluency in German and English. A passion for safety, compliance, and continuous improvement. Why Join Huntsman? At Huntsman, you will work in an international environment with colleagues across different functions. We offer: The opportunity to contribute to important automotive-related projects at the Bad Säckingen site. A varied role with close interaction across engineering, production and maintenance teams. Opportunities for professional development and learning. A supportive culture where safety, ethics and collaboration are important. Interested? If this role matches your experience and interests, we look forward to receiving your application. Our Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and guide you through the recruitment process. About Huntsman At Huntsman, we pride ourselves on being a people-oriented organization. Our family-like atmosphere is cultivated by our diverse groups of team members around the world. We welcome the talent, experience and fresh ideas that employees at all stages of their careers, from interns to seasoned professionals, bring to Huntsman. In return, we offer you the opportunity to become an integral part of a dynamic, industry-leading company, where safety and ethics always come first. Additional Locations:

What We’re Looking For We are searching for a proactive, hands-on engineer with: A degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or related field). 3+ years’ experience in engineering and maintenance roles within manufacturing, ideally with a strong automotive or chemical background. closest.title: Quality Engineer - HROC
closest.text: Reporting to : Functional Engineering Lead – HROC Job Purpose: In this role, you will be responsible for providing technical support and expertise in quality control to multiple cement plant sites within a designated region. Based in a central location remote to the plants, you will collaborate closely with plant teams to establish and maintain quality control measures, implement testing protocols, and drive continuous improvement initiatives. Occasional travel to the plant sites supported will be required Roles and Responsibilities: Quality Control Measures: Support plants to establish and implement quality control measures across multiple cement plant sites to ensure compliance with quality standards, specifications, and regulatory requirements. Develop and maintain quality control procedures, work instructions, and inspection protocols. Testing and Inspection: Support plants in defining and optimizing quality testing and calibration processes to evaluate the physical and chemical properties of cement and raw materials. Coordinate and perform laboratory tests, analyze results, and communicate findings to plant teams. Ensure adherence to testing protocols and accuracy of measurements. Quality Assurance Programs: Collaborate with plant teams to implement quality assurance programs, including process control systems, statistical process control (SPC), and corrective action procedures. Monitor process variables, analyze data, and initiate corrective actions to maintain product quality within specifications. Root Cause Analysis: Investigate quality deviations and non-conformities, using root cause analysis techniques to identify underlying causes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement effective corrective and preventive actions, ensuring the resolution of quality issues. Supplier Quality Management: Collaborate with procurement teams to establish and enforce quality standards for incoming raw materials and additives. Conduct supplier audits, evaluate supplier performance, and collaborate with vendors to address quality-related issues. Monitor and communicate supplier quality metrics. Data Analysis and Reporting: Collect, analyze, and interpret quality data, including test results, inspection records, and customer feedback. Generate reports and visualizations to communicate quality performance and trends. Provide recommendations for process improvements based on data analysis. Training and Knowledge Sharing: Provide training and guidance to plant personnel on quality control procedures, testing methods, and quality assurance techniques. Foster a culture of quality awareness and continuous improvement by sharing knowledge and best practices with plant teams. Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives by actively seeking opportunities to enhance quality control processes, reduce variability, and improve product quality. Special focus is on clinker incorporation and reduced CO2-footprint of our products. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement improvement projects and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) Job Qualifications, Requirements & Experience: Education Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field. Minimum 8 years previous experience in quality management in the cement industry. Strong knowledge of quality management principles, quality control techniques, and quality assurance practices. Familiarity with cement manufacturing processes, product specifications, and relevant industry standards. Experience in implementing and maintaining quality management systems, such as ISO 9001, is desirable. Proficiency in statistical process control (SPC), data analysis tools, and quality management software. Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex quality issues and implement effective solutions. Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute multiple tasks concurrently in a remote support role. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with plant teams and stakeholders remotely. Ability to communicate fluently and effectively with international stakeholders in English. Strong training and coaching abilities. A proactive team player who thrives in a supportive, high-energy environment. Work Week: European

closestEng.title: Senior Platform Engineer – Developer Experience (m/w/d)
closestEng.text: About Us Ready to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide. For the better. Together. * Build the platform behind modern logistics * Bei Hellmann bauen wir das Fundament, auf dem unsere Entwicklungsteams digitale Produkte liefern, betreiben und skalieren. Das Berufsbild von Entwickler*innen verändert sich schneller als in den letzten zwanzig Jahren. Code zu erzeugen wird zunehmend delegierbar; was bleibt, ist die Fähigkeit, Systeme als Ganzes zu verstehen und die Plattform zu bauen, auf der andere produktiv werden. * Was wir unter „Plattform" verstehen * Unsere Plattform ist das Nervensystem für geschäftskritische Services: • Runtime: Unsere Plattform trägt geschäftskritische Anwendungen rund um die Uhr. Deshalb bauen wir sie auf Stabilität, Resilienz und einen verlässlichen Betrieb aus. • Observability: Werkzeuge, die Vorfälle erklären und alarmieren, statt Lärm zu machen. • Governance: Guardrails und Golden Paths, die Security direkt in den Workflow integrieren. • Self-Service: Damit Entwickler*innen produktiv sind, ohne auf ein Ticket zu warten. • Developer Experience: Damit das alles nicht nur funktioniert, sondern richtig Laune macht. Auf unserer Plattform laufen das Hellmann Kundenportal, die Transport Management Systeme für den europäischen Landverkehr, Anwendungen für Luft- und Seefracht und eine wachsende Zahl weiterer Services. Dazu zählt auch ein öffentliches API-Gateway, das nicht nur von Menschen bedient wird. Über den Job Platform as a Product. Du entwickelst unsere AWS- und Kubernetes-Plattform gemeinsam mit den Entwicklungsteams weiter – von der Anforderung über Golden Paths bis zum stabilen Betrieb. Kill the Ticket. Du baust wiederverwendbare Terraform-Module und Tools, damit Teams sich selbst bedienen können. Code over Click. Was zweimal manuell passiert, wird automatisiert. GitOps macht Infrastruktur berechenbar. Code ist unsere Single Source of Truth. Real-World Security. Mit Policy-as-Code (Kyverno) wird Compliance Teil des Workflows. Efficiency first. Skalierung und Kosten gehen Hand in Hand. Karpenter ist dein Werkzeug, nicht dein Gegner. AI-Powered Engineering. AI spielt eine zentrale Rolle in unserer Automatisierung und Workflows. Wir nutzen Claude und andere Tools aktiv, nicht nur experimentell. Unser Tech-Stack Überwiegend Open Source, aber wo Enterprise-Software die bessere Wahl ist, setzen wir die genauso ein. Cloud & Runtime: AWS, Kubernetes, Karpenter IaC & GitOps: Terraform, Atlantis, GitLab, Argo CD, Helm Policy-as-Code: Kyverno Databases & Caching: RDS, DocumentDB, ElastiCache Messaging & Streaming: MSK/Kafka, RabbitMQ Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Mimir AI: Claude, AWS Bedrock Sprachen: Go, Python, Bash Über Dich Infrastruktur-Profi. Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit AWS und Kubernetes im „echten Leben" inklusive Troubleshooting. Automatisierungs-Fanatiker. IaC und Automation liegen dir im Blut. Manuelle Arbeit wird bei dir Code, nicht Dokumentation. Problemlöser. Linux, Container und Networking tief genug, um auch dann ruhig zu bleiben, wenn ein Deployment hakt. Empathischer Engineer. Du willst, dass andere Entwickler*innen ihren Job gerne machen. Sprachgewandt. Englisch ist unsere gemeinsame Sprache in Meetings, Doku und Reviews. Was zusätzlich hilfreich ist Erfahrung mit Teilen unseres Stacks (ArgoCD, Karpenter, Atlantis, Kyverno, Loki, Mimir o. ä.) FinOps oder Cloud Cost Optimization aus der Praxis Erfahrung mit internen Plattformen, Golden Paths, Developer Tooling oder eigenen CLIs Workflow-Engines wie n8n oder Argo Workflows Open-Source-Beiträge in Form von Code, Issues, Dokumentation oder Maintainer-Arbeit Über unsere Vorteile: Hellmann Spirit: Du-Kultur im gesamten Unternehmen, Regelmäßige Team- und Firmenevents, Geburtstagslos der Deutschen Fernsehlotterie Work-Life-Integration: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Mobiles Arbeiten Finanzielle Zusatzleistungen: Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Bis zu 1.600€ Netto Prämie für die Empfehlung von neuen Kolleg*innen, Vergünstigungen und Angebote für Reisen, Freizeit und Kultur Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden: Firmenfitness über Hansefit, Mobile Massage während der Arbeitszeit, Mental Health- und Gesundheitscoaching, Täglich wechselnde und vielseitige Gerichte in unserer Kantine Familie: Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung, Urlaubstage für die Pflege von Angehörigen und bei besonderen Ereignissen Fachliche & persönliche Entwicklung: Newcomer Days, Weiterbildung und Trainingsangebote durch unsere Academy, Digitale Lernplattform (LearningHub) Mobilität: Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket, Kostenfreie Parkplätze, Kostenfreie Nutzung der e-Ladesäulen Ausstattung: Handy, Laptop Inclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you! If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY! Any open questions? Please feel free to contact our responsible Recruiter.
